scope: Independent read-only review of parent-authored compact/mobile topbar delta only; excludes reviewer-authored ROOT badge move and conversion consent logic.

Checked cloud action preserves project guard, process action mounts and selects the same panel, and menu activation/Escape use existing focus and close handlers.

limits: Not a full-web audit. No additional tests or visual/network actions performed for this narrow review.
